settings.text: Service & support through the EEB dealer network

settings.subtitle: Purpose-built adaptive electric tricycle for supported riding, therapy and everyday freedom

settings.text: Adjustable seat positioning and handlebar setup

settings.heading: Rider Support, Rider First
settings.body: A very low centre of gravity, ultra-low step-through and highly configurable support system means riders with a wide range of physical and developmental needs can experience the freedom of riding a bike — comfortably and safely.

settings.text: Rear brake and power controls for carers
Also available without rear steer for independent riders

settings.heading: Rear-Steer for Carers
settings.body: The most popular configuration adds a rear-steering arm on which brake and power controls can be mounted — letting a carer safely guide and stop the trike while the rider pedals and enjoys the experience.

settings.text: Fixed-gear as standard for therapy applications

settings.heading: Fixed / Free-Wheel Options
settings.body: Standard drivetrain is a simple fixed-gear, where pedals turn with the trike. Our most popular upgrade offers a fixed/free-wheel interchange hub — letting the rider rest or develop the skills to ride independently.

settings.title: Mechanical
settings.rows:
Frame | Heavy-duty steel
Wheel sizes | 16" or 20"
Drivetrain | Fixed-gear standard, optional fixed/free-wheel
Brakes | Front and rear, optional carer control
Parking brake | Integrated
Step-through | Ultra-low for easy transfer

settings.title: Electrical
settings.rows:
Motor | 250W front hub
Battery | 36V (optional larger-capacity upgrade)
Assist | Multi-level pedal assist

settings.title: Adaptive Options
settings.rows:
Steering | Rear-steer arm (optional)
Support | Backrests, lateral supports, seatbelt
Harness | Optional 4-point harness
Max rider load | 110 kg
Applications | Adaptive cycling, rehab, supported riding
